relations.text: 引受契約に基づく保険料が売上の30%(2025年)
relations.text_en: Premiums written for it were 30% of 2025 revenue

source.label: Trupanion 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, premiums from policies written for Pets Best, pursuant to our agreements with them, accounted for 30% of our total revenue.
